title: 12-layer ZnS/ZnSe stack with frozen outer/inner quarter-wave segments
scientific_hypothesis: Freezing outermost and innermost 2 layers as quarter-wave matching segments at the MWIR edge (4000 nm center) while optimizing the central 8 layers will improve spectral nulling depth in 3000-5000 nm band without degrading LWIR transmittance, achieving higher target score than the 8-layer baseline (0.2566).
design_principle: Quarter-wave stack principle for reflection band formation at MWIR, with fixed matching layers at interfaces to reduce impedance mismatch, while central layers provide degrees of freedom for spectral shape optimization.
proposed_topology: exactly 12 finite layers from the incident side: ZnSe / ZnS / ZnSe / ZnS / ZnSe / ZnS / ZnSe / ZnS / ZnSe / ZnS / ZnSe / ZnS
manufacturing_considerations: Fixed outer/inner layers simplify alignment and reduce optimization complexity
Thickness bounds ~700-800 nm per layer for central layers
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory for dichroic filter design
Impedance matching at interfaces reduces reflection losses
expected_advantages: Fixed outer layers provide stable interface matching
Central 8 layers offer sufficient optimization freedom
12 layers utilize more of the 16-layer budget than prior 8-layer attempt
known_risks: Fixed layer thicknesses may constrain optimal solution space
Material absorption in MWIR/LWIR bands not fully characterized
Thickness tolerance sensitivity not yet analyzed
execution_request_english: Perform one bounded TMM thickness optimization for an exactly 12-layer planar stack. Use the fixed material sequence from the incident side: ZnSe / ZnS / ZnSe / ZnS / ZnSe / ZnS / ZnSe / ZnS / ZnSe / ZnS / ZnSe / ZnS. Optimize only the physical thickness of each finite layer within the user-declared bounds. Do not optimize material identity or layer count in this route. Execute coherent TMM optimization for a 12-layer ZnS/ZnSe dielectric stack on Ge substrate at normal incidence. Layer sequence: ZnS|ZnSe|ZnS|ZnSe|ZnS|ZnSe|ZnS|ZnSe|ZnS|ZnSe|ZnS|ZnSe (12 finite layers). Freeze layers 1, 2, 11, 12 at quarter-wave optical thickness centered at 4000 nm (MWIR band center). Optimize thicknesses of layers 3-10 (8 central layers) with bounds 500-1000 nm. Wavelength bands: 8000-11000 nm (high transmittance target), 3000-5000 nm (low transmittance target). Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with 100 iterations. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates count, tightest_margin, and thicknesses_nm for all candidates. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 8000-11000 nm, 3000-5000 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band; Low transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: High transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count not exceeding 16.
revision_reason: Direct implementation of feedback directive: 12-layer count with frozen outer/inner quarter-wave segments at MWIR edge, central 8 layers optimizable with rescaled thickness bounds (~700-800 nm target per layer).
